lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast vertical white lines are visible; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, becoming more compressed at the anterior shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 7th stripe from the posterior, splitting into a Y-shape at the upper third of the torso mass; a partial secondary line segment merges with the 4th stripe near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Stripes 1 and 2 at the posterior terminate at mid-flank; several small white dashes are visible between stripes 4 and 5 on the lower lateral torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 5 distinct white circular spots located on the lower posterior haunch, primarily concentrated above the tarsal joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the mid-thigh align in a diagonal trajectory (approximately 45 degrees) leading toward the ventral line.

other_distinctive_markers: Three high-contrast white spots visible on the facial region (two on the lower cheek, one on the bridge of the nose); dark dorsal ridge line extending from the neck to the rump; white horizontal bands present on the lower limbs above the hooves.
